field.label: Manage sleep schedule
field.help: Let OPNsense own the dish sleep schedule. The window below is in this firewall's local time and is re-applied every 5 minutes, so daylight-saving changes are corrected automatically and changes made in the Starlink app are reverted. Use Wake on the Status tab for temporary overrides.

field.label: Wake at
field.help: Local time, 24-hour HH:MM. May be earlier than "Sleep from" to span midnight.
